claim.summary: Over any field F, for a finite set X in F^n, B_D the polynomials of degree <=D vanishing on X, U=V_K/(B_D cap V_K) and errors E_1..E_s of degree <=e with K+e<=D: the map u->[E_j u] in V_D/B_D has rank dim U|_{S_j}, S_j the support of E_j on X, and the stacked map has rank dim U|_S, S the union of the supports; the restriction U|_S -> direct sum of U|_{S_j} is injective, so the sum of ranks exceeds the stacked rank by its cokernel dimension. With X the Boolean cube over F_p this is the domain-only model of cor:pang-observation-calibration at Pang's cutoff Delta+K+d<=D, where every saving over the sum is a union-of-supports interpolation count; such savings carry into Pang's proper quotient since B_D is inside C_D.

claim.summary: Over F2 in a Boolean degree-D pseudoideal on v>=1 old variables, M>=1 fixed actual degree-delta>=1 tuples, weight degree<=b and fixed parent prefactors degree<=p0, use canonical descending-echelon V=span all inputs and its degree-d split V=A_d direct-sum B_d,G_a=L_a direct-sum Q_a, with pi_a(A_d)=L_a,pi_a(B_d)=Q_a. Here 1<=d<=min(K,delta),K<=v,k>=0,t>=1,h=k+t,H=dim[wV_K]>0 and b+p0+K+(h+1)delta<=D. In the restricted first-k-high/last-t-low law, write g_ai=ell_ai+z_ai literally, C_a for high prefix,S_a for low tail; F_k=rank(f in V_K -> (wP_a C_a z_ai f)),mu=E F_k/H, and nu=E rank(f -> (wP_a C_a S_a ell_ai f))/H. If mu+nu<1, the original full-uniform canonical completed rank has E E_h<=[1-alpha(1-mu-nu)]H<H,alpha=2^(-k dim A_d-t dim B_d). More sharply, restrict the low reference map to U_C=ker high map and put nu0=E restricted rank/H. The same conclusion holds with nu0 in place of nu, and nu0<=nu: the evolved high map vanishes on U_C within the paid buffer, and a complement of dimension F_k gives rank<=F_k+restricted low rank. The automatic bound restricted low rank<=H-F_k does not supply strict deficit. Ordinary full-domain marginal contraction gives nu<=rho=M(1-eta)^t,eta=N_v(K-d)/(2N_v(K)); no parent independence or conditioned-domain ratio is assumed. Every other full-grid map has rank<=H by bounded absorption. With all L_a zero, nu=0 rather than requiring the crude rho. These criteria remain sufficient, not necessary because cancellation outside U_C can lower rank. They select one original-domain multiplier and coherent constant rows, retaining earlier obligations and original charges. No source-wide mu,nu or nu0 bound, all-level removal or Frege lower bound follows.

claim.summary: On a smooth projective geometrically integral curve over a finite field, genus g, n distinct received rational points plus protected R, divisors A,G of degrees a,m>=0 avoiding all points, L received words from L(G) with exact error supports E_j, union size u and maximum size t: if a>=u+2g and n>a+m+t, actual error actions on common U=L(A) and their observed maps modulo ev L(A+G) have individual ranks |E_j| and joint rank u; their common kernel evaluates surjectively at R. One common normalized locator is found from the received words and recovers every message, in O(Ln^3) field operations and O(n^2+Ln) memory with bases/evaluations supplied. On Hermitian curves s=2^r>=8, n=s^3-1,g=s(s-1)/2,m=s^3/4-1,d=s^3/16-1,a=3d+2g, supports I union J and I union K for disjoint d-sets give ranks 2d,2d, joint 3d and incomparable kernels. The summed-rank criterion for a nonzero common multiplier first holds at pole order 4d+g (for every support choice when s>=16; with support-based rank bounds at s=8); a nonzero common multiplier exists at 3d+g and a protected one at a, savings d and d-g, with both windows feasible. Joint rank is union size by definition here; separate per-word locators are cheaper; no bound on paid PC errors or hardness transfer.
